name: Ugao-Miraballes (Spain)
description: Red field with an embattled white stripe and a dark blue stripe along the lower edge, charged towards the top with the municipal arms of Ugao-Miraballes (a castle and a cauldron on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Ugao-Miraballes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: embattled division between the red and the white
Ugao-Miraballes arms — castle and cauldron on yellow
